sentences.en: Brian intends to strictly limit the money he uses.
sentences.zh: 1. 布莱恩打算严格限制他使用的钱。

sentences.en: But today smoking in public places is forbidden or strictly restricted.
sentences.zh: 2. 但是今天在公共场所吸烟是被禁止或严格限制的。

sentences.en: It was strictly a family affair for Sam Jones.
sentences.zh: 3. 对山姆·琼斯来说，这完全是家庭内部的事。
